description: This Java source file defines an abstract Android activity class 'LoggingActivity' that logs lifecycle events and configuration changes, and manages logging output to both logcat and UI components.

classes.name: LoggingActivity
classes.description: An abstract activity class that logs lifecycle callbacks and configuration changes, and manages logging display in the UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and logs the creation event.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Logs the post-create lifecycle event, with an overload accepting PersistableBundle.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Logs when the activity is paused.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Logs when the activity is destroyed.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Logs configuration changes such as orientation changes.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts logging to UI and logs the start event.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Stops logging to UI and logs the stop event.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain and UI log fragment.

methods.name: stopLogging
methods.description: Removes log node to stop logging.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets description text in UI if available.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets background color of a view in UI if available.
